purpose: 12 independent upstream capability acceptance scenarios; none counted as PROVEN
github_milestone: Independent source/license/runtime receipts on exact-head CI; OSi operations prohibited
cost_boundary: No mandatory paid APIs; access/licensing checks precede execution

cases.capability: Codex skill discovery and AGENTS.md precedence
cases.real_task: A controlled repository-level instruction fixture runs with Codex in an authorized zero-additional-cost runtime.
cases.required_evidence: Actual executable run, stdout/stderr, version, exact source SHA and reviewer

cases.capability: Claude Code SKILL.md discovery and project rules
cases.real_task: A controlled Claude skill fixture is discovered and executes one deterministic task within permitted account access.
cases.required_evidence: Actual session trace, account entitlement, source/license decision and independent review

cases.real_task: Validate the same ENGURU skill metadata with an upstream-compatible validator on GitHub CI.
cases.required_evidence: Tool version pin, test log, fixture and reproducible acceptance

cases.real_task: Select a known upstream SKILL.md, verify its governing per-skill license, and compare accepted metadata fields.
cases.required_evidence: Per-skill license, content SHA and structured test log

cases.real_task: Perform a local-only stdio handshake to a vetted reference server with isolated fixture payload.
cases.required_evidence: Pinned source, message transcript, test log, sandbox policy and review

cases.real_task: Run an in-process protocol exchange with matched protocol version and no network egress.
cases.required_evidence: Protocol version, source SHA, CI transcript, independent reviewer

cases.real_task: Run a fixture in CI with explicit Node and protocol version pins.
cases.required_evidence: CI log, exact package hash, fixture protocol transcript

cases.real_task: Run a local provider fixture with reproducible candidate/baseline criteria and no paid API.
cases.required_evidence: Eval results, source/test SHA and sample count

cases.real_task: Execute seeded property tests against ENGURU evidence gates with shrinking counterexamples.
cases.required_evidence: Seed, pinned package version, CI tests and failures

cases.real_task: Lint the ENGURU Harvest source on exact-head with a pinned Ruff release and configuration.
cases.required_evidence: Full lint report, repository SHA and policy-reviewed rules

cases.real_task: Build or validate an isolated dependency lock for the candidate benchmark with a pinned tool.
cases.required_evidence: Lock digest, supply chain checks, version, CI report

cases.real_task: Compare an offline deterministic mock evaluator to documented harness schema, then run a pinned harness fixture.
cases.required_evidence: Task hash, model fixture, scored outputs, runtime evidence
